tools.name: trnch_stats
tools.description: Read live public numbers for the last 24 hours: tokens spotted, tokens in the Heat, tokens kept out as High risk, rugs detected, median detection delay in seconds, number of routers and the bot fee in percent. No key needed.

tools.name: trnch_register_message
tools.description: Step 1 of 2 to get an API key, no browser. Returns { message }: the exact text your wallet must sign with personal_sign (EIP-191). It is valid for 10 minutes and moves no funds.

tools.name: trnch_register
tools.description: Step 2 of 2: send the message returned in step 1 and its signature; returns { key, prefix, wallet } with status 201. The key is shown once, store it. tools.description: Get a signed webhook POST when a token a wallet holds is newly flagged by Trnch. Give wallet (any address) and webhookUrl (https, a public domain name, port 443; IPs, localhost and private or internal names are refused). Each alert carries the token, the Trnch verdict { status, category, rugged, dum

tools.name: trnch_alerts_list
tools.description: List the wallet alert subscriptions of this key: id, wallet, webhook URL, failures in a row, disabled flag and lastDelivery (delivered or failed). The secret is never returned again. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: trnch_alerts_unsubscribe
tools.description: Remove one wallet alert subscription of this key by id (from trnch_alerts_list). 404 if it does not exist. Requires an API key (created by wallet signature), sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trnch_check, trnch_register_message, trnch_heat, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Private data: trnch_stats, trnch_check, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_24h, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_quote, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Destructive: trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trnch_check, trnch_register_message, trnch_heat, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Private data: trnch_stats, trnch_check, trnch_scan_wallet, trnch_top_24h, trnch_register_message, trnch_register, trnch_heat, trnch_quote, trnch_buy, trnch_sell, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe · Public sink: trnch_register, trnch_confirm, trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_list · Destructive: trnch_alerts_subscribe, trnch_alerts_unsubscribe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
